summary: Implemented DB-native search with PostgreSQL FTS/ILIKE and GIN index, keyword and tag filtering, 1-based pagination with 0-based offset calculation, strict page_size capping (max 100), allowlisted sorting, and query-level tenant scoping.
evidence: 55/55 automated unit, security, caching, queue, search, and pagination tests passing in pytest (apps/api/tests/test_search_and_pagination.py).
Live probe verified: GET /links/search accurately returned matching links by keyword substring (q=kubernetes) and tag (tag=devops).
Pagination verified: returned metadata (page, page_size, total, total_pages) and disjoint records across consecutive pages (no off-by-one errors).
DoS protection verified: requesting page_size=500 was capped to page_size=100.
Tenant isolation verified: Tenant Beta search returned 0 results for Tenant Alpha's links.
Allowlist validation verified: unsupported sort_by fields rejected with HTTP 422.
